package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode is persisted independently of the legacy
// Teacher decision/AI execution fields.  In particular, causal AI execution
// identity is never the opaque confidential execution row ID.
type TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode = "onboarding_action"
	TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText   TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode = "onboarding_text"
)

type TeacherOnboardingTurnStage string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived            TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "received"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "interaction_reserved"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged            TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "ai_staged"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged       TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "student_staged"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged      TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "response_staged"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending     TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "delivery_pending"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnDelivered           TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "delivered"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect      TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "failed_no_effect"
	TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown      TeacherOnboardingTurnStage = "blocked_unknown"
)

// TeacherOnboardingDeliveryDisposition is recomputed after restart only from
// durable turn effect and staged response UI fields. It prevents a terminal
// no-UI response from being confused with a response-only tangent.
type TeacherOnboardingDeliveryDisposition string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingDeliveryUnbound       TeacherOnboardingDeliveryDisposition = "unbound"
	TeacherOnboardingDeliveryPreserve      TeacherOnboardingDeliveryDisposition = "preserve_prompt"
	TeacherOnboardingDeliveryReplace       TeacherOnboardingDeliveryDisposition = "replace_prompt"
	TeacherOnboardingDeliveryCloseTerminal TeacherOnboardingDeliveryDisposition = "close_terminal"
)

func ProductAwareOnboardingDeliveryDisposition(turn TeacherOnboardingTurn, responseHasUI bool) (TeacherOnboardingDeliveryDisposition, error) {
	if turn.InteractionID == "" {
		if responseHasUI {
			return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		return TeacherOnboardingDeliveryUnbound, nil
	}
	if responseHasUI {
		return TeacherOnboardingDeliveryReplace, nil
	}
	switch turn.StudentEffectState {
	case TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted:
		return TeacherOnboardingDeliveryCloseTerminal, nil
	case TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect:
		return TeacherOnboardingDeliveryPreserve, nil
	default:
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
}

type TeacherOnboardingInteractionState string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive         TeacherOnboardingInteractionState = "active"
	TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved       TeacherOnboardingInteractionState = "reserved"
	TeacherOnboardingInteractionSuperseded     TeacherOnboardingInteractionState = "superseded"
	TeacherOnboardingInteractionCompleted      TeacherOnboardingInteractionState = "completed"
	TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosed         TeacherOnboardingInteractionState = "closed"
	TeacherOnboardingInteractionHandoffPending TeacherOnboardingInteractionState = "handoff_pending"
)

type TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingClosedPlanningReady    TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason = "planning_ready"
	TeacherOnboardingClosedActivePathExists TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason = "active_path_exists"
)

type TeacherOnboardingSlotCode string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection     TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "direction_code"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience    TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "self_assessed_experience"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks   TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "known_stacks"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "desired_stacks"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode      TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "goal_code"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText      TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "goal_text"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage      TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "preferred_language"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "weekly_minutes"
	TeacherOnboardingSlotPace          TeacherOnboardingSlotCode = "preferred_pace"
)

type TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted          TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState = "not_attempted"
	TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted              TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState = "accepted"
	TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect              TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState = "no_effect"
	TeacherOnboardingEffectUnknown               TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState = "unknown_effect"
	TeacherOnboardingEffectCommittedUnreconciled TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState = "committed_unreconciled"
)

// TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision is the small, validated S5 recovery
// record written before Student is called. It stores no prompt variables,
// provider envelope, model response/body or opaque execution ID: only the
// typed operational projection needed to retry one atomic Student mutation or
// a server-owned confirmation. Policy v1 stores one candidate; policy v2 may
// store several exact low-risk candidates. The user-visible reply is staged
// separately on the existing Teacher job, never duplicated here.
type TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionKind string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation     TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionKind = "mutation"
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionKind = "confirmation"
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionResponseOnly TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionKind = "response_only"
)

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision struct {
	Kind          TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionKind `json:"kind"`
	Candidate     *TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate   `json:"candidate,omitempty"`
	Candidates    []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate  `json:"candidates,omitempty"`
	PolicyVersion int                                   `json:"policy_version,omitempty"`
	Digest        string                                `json:"-"`
}

// TeacherOnboardingInteraction is local Teacher orchestration state. It has
// only bindings, versions, registry slot and state; Student remains the sole
// owner of draft/profile values and provenance.
type TeacherOnboardingInteraction struct {
	ID                      string
	DialogID                string
	StudentID               string
	PersonalTeacherID       string
	PromptMessageID         string
	PromptMessageVersion    int64
	PromptAssistantUIDigest string
	SlotCode                TeacherOnboardingSlotCode
	ExpectedDraftVersion    int64
	ExpectedProfileVersion  int64
	SessionSchemaVersion    int
	State                   TeacherOnboardingInteractionState
	ReservedTeacherJobID    string
	ReservedActionReceiptID string
	ReservationMode         TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode
	SupersededByID          string
	CompletedAt             time.Time
	ClosedReason            TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason
	ClosedAt                time.Time
	CreatedAt               time.Time
	UpdatedAt               time.Time
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(input TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.PromptMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PromptMessageID)
	input.PromptAssistantUIDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.PromptAssistantUIDigest))
	input.ReservedTeacherJobID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReservedTeacherJobID)
	input.ReservedActionReceiptID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReservedActionReceiptID)
	input.SupersededByID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SupersededByID)
	input.ClosedReason = TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ClosedReason)))
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	input.CompletedAt = input.CompletedAt.UTC()
	input.ClosedAt = input.ClosedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(input.ID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) ||
		!validUUID(input.PromptMessageID) || input.PromptMessageVersion < 1 || !validTeacherActionReceiptDigest(input.PromptAssistantUIDigest) ||
		!validTeacherOnboardingSlot(input.SlotCode) || input.ExpectedDraftVersion < 0 || input.ExpectedProfileVersion < 0 ||
		(input.SessionSchemaVersion < 1 || input.SessionSchemaVersion > 3) ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if input.ReservedTeacherJobID != "" && !validUUID(input.ReservedTeacherJobID) ||
		input.ReservedActionReceiptID != "" && !validUUID(input.ReservedActionReceiptID) ||
		input.SupersededByID != "" && !validUUID(input.SupersededByID) {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	switch input.State {
	case TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive:
		if input.ReservedTeacherJobID != "" || input.ReservedActionReceiptID != "" || input.ReservationMode != "" || input.SupersededByID != "" || !input.CompletedAt.IsZero() || input.ClosedReason != "" || !input.ClosedAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved:
		if input.ReservedTeacherJobID == "" || input.SupersededByID != "" || !input.CompletedAt.IsZero() || input.ClosedReason != "" || !input.ClosedAt.IsZero() ||
			(input.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction && input.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText) ||
			(input.ReservationMode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction && input.ReservedActionReceiptID == "") ||
			(input.ReservationMode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText && input.ReservedActionReceiptID != "") {
			return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingInteractionSuperseded:
		if input.SupersededByID == "" || input.ReservedTeacherJobID != "" || input.ReservedActionReceiptID != "" || input.ReservationMode != "" || !input.CompletedAt.IsZero() || input.ClosedReason != "" || !input.ClosedAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingInteractionCompleted:
		if input.CompletedAt.IsZero() || input.ReservedTeacherJobID == "" || input.SupersededByID != "" || input.ClosedReason != "" || !input.ClosedAt.IsZero() ||
			(input.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction && input.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText) ||
			(input.ReservationMode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction && input.ReservedActionReceiptID == "") ||
			(input.ReservationMode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText && input.ReservedActionReceiptID != "") {
			return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosed:
		if input.ReservedTeacherJobID != "" || input.ReservedActionReceiptID != "" || input.ReservationMode != "" || input.SupersededByID != "" || !input.CompletedAt.IsZero() ||
			(input.ClosedReason != TeacherOnboardingClosedPlanningReady && input.ClosedReason != TeacherOnboardingClosedActivePathExists) || input.ClosedAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingInteractionHandoffPending:
		if input.ReservedTeacherJobID == "" || input.SupersededByID != "" || !input.CompletedAt.IsZero() ||
			input.ClosedReason != TeacherOnboardingClosedPlanningReady || input.ClosedAt.IsZero() ||
			(input.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction && input.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText) ||
			(input.ReservationMode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction && input.ReservedActionReceiptID == "") ||
			(input.ReservationMode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText && input.ReservedActionReceiptID != "") {
			return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

// TeacherOnboardingTurn is one 1:1 durable mode-specific projection of a
// Dialog job. It never retains raw Student values or model output.
type TeacherOnboardingTurn struct {
	TeacherJobID              string
	SourceEventID             string
	InteractionID             string
	Mode                      TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorMode
	Stage                     TeacherOnboardingTurnStage
	ActionReceiptID           string
	CausalAIExecutionID       string
	FallbackAIExecutionID     string
	StudentCommandID          string
	ResponseCommandID         string
	StudentEffectState        TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState
	NoEffectProofID           string
	RecoverableOutcomeID      string
	ResponseAssistantUIDigest string
	SemanticDecision          *TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision
	CreatedAt                 time.Time
	UpdatedAt                 time.Time
}

func NewTeacherOnboardingTurn(input TeacherOnboardingTurn) (TeacherOnboardingTurn, error) {
	for field := range map[*string]struct{}{
		&input.TeacherJobID: {}, &input.SourceEventID: {}, &input.InteractionID: {}, &input.ActionReceiptID: {},
		&input.CausalAIExecutionID: {}, &input.FallbackAIExecutionID: {}, &input.StudentCommandID: {},
		&input.ResponseCommandID: {}, &input.NoEffectProofID: {}, &input.RecoverableOutcomeID: {},
	} {
		*field = strings.TrimSpace(*field)
	}
	input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest))
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	for _, value := range []string{input.TeacherJobID, input.SourceEventID, input.StudentCommandID, input.ResponseCommandID} {
		if !validUUID(value) {
			return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	}
	for _, value := range []string{input.InteractionID, input.ActionReceiptID, input.CausalAIExecutionID, input.FallbackAIExecutionID, input.NoEffectProofID, input.RecoverableOutcomeID} {
		if value != "" && !validUUID(value) {
			return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	}
	if input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) ||
		(input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest != "" && !validTeacherActionReceiptDigest(input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest)) ||
		(input.CausalAIExecutionID != "" && input.FallbackAIExecutionID != "") {
		return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if input.SemanticDecision != nil {
		decision, decisionErr := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(*input.SemanticDecision)
		if decisionErr != nil || input.Mode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText {
			return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		input.SemanticDecision = &decision
	}
	if (input.Mode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction) != (input.ActionReceiptID != "") ||
		(input.Mode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction && input.Mode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText) {
		return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if input.StudentEffectState == "" {
		input.StudentEffectState = TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted
	}
	if input.StudentEffectState != TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted && input.StudentEffectState != TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted &&
		input.StudentEffectState != TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect && input.StudentEffectState != TeacherOnboardingEffectUnknown &&
		input.StudentEffectState != TeacherOnboardingEffectCommittedUnreconciled {
		return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	// Student owns a no-effect proof.  It is durable evidence for both a
	// normally delivered clarification and a failed_no_effect terminal path;
	// only the latter also has a Teacher-created recoverable outcome.
	if (input.StudentEffectState == TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect) != (input.NoEffectProofID != "") ||
		(input.Stage == TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect) != (input.StudentEffectState == TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect && input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "") ||
		(input.Stage != TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect && input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "") {
		return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	switch input.Stage {
	case TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived, TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved, TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged,
		TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending,
		TeacherOnboardingTurnDelivered, TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect, TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown:
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validTeacherOnboardingSlot(slot TeacherOnboardingSlotCode) bool {
	switch slot {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks,
		TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks, TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText,
		TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage, TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes, TeacherOnboardingSlotPace:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func TeacherOnboardingSlotForStep(step TeacherOnboardingStep) (TeacherOnboardingSlotCode, bool) {
	switch step {
	case OnboardingStepDirection:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, true
	case OnboardingStepExperience:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, true
	case OnboardingStepKnownStack:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks, true
	case OnboardingStepDesiredStack:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks, true
	case OnboardingStepGoal:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, true
	case OnboardingStepLanguage:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage, true
	case OnboardingStepWeeklyMinutes:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes, true
	case OnboardingStepPace:
		return TeacherOnboardingSlotPace, true
	default:
		return "", false
	}
}

// NewS5OnboardingInteraction deterministically binds one registry-built
// Teacher prompt to the exact Student versions it expects. It does not copy a
// draft value; the digest is evidence that the prompt itself was not changed.
func NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, step TeacherOnboardingStep, draftVersion, profileVersion int64, sessionSchemaVersion int, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	return newS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, message, "", step, draftVersion, profileVersion, sessionSchemaVersion, now)
}

// NewS5OnboardingInteractionForResponse binds a prompt returned by Dialog's
// normal teacher-response route. Unlike a legacy proactive message, that
// route deliberately anchors the Teacher prompt to the Student turn it
// answers. The anchor is evidence, not browser input: it must be the exact
// expected source message ID.
func NewS5OnboardingInteractionForResponse(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, replyToMessageID string, step TeacherOnboardingStep, draftVersion, profileVersion int64, sessionSchemaVersion int, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	return newS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, message, replyToMessageID, step, draftVersion, profileVersion, sessionSchemaVersion, now)
}

func newS5OnboardingInteraction(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, replyToMessageID string, step TeacherOnboardingStep, draftVersion, profileVersion int64, sessionSchemaVersion int, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	normalizedBinding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	slot, hasSlot := TeacherOnboardingSlotForStep(step)
	if err != nil || !hasSlot || normalizedBinding.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral || draftVersion < 0 || profileVersion < 0 || now.IsZero() {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	validated, err := newS5TeacherPromptMessage(normalizedBinding, message, replyToMessageID)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	digest, err := DigestTeacherAssistantUI(validated.AssistantUI)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	interaction := TeacherOnboardingInteraction{
		ID:       DeterministicOnboardingUUID("interaction", normalizedBinding.ID, validated.ID, validated.Version, digest, slot, draftVersion, profileVersion, sessionSchemaVersion),
		DialogID: normalizedBinding.ID, StudentID: normalizedBinding.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: normalizedBinding.PersonalTeacherID,
		PromptMessageID: validated.ID, PromptMessageVersion: int64(validated.Version), PromptAssistantUIDigest: digest, SlotCode: slot,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: draftVersion, ExpectedProfileVersion: profileVersion, SessionSchemaVersion: sessionSchemaVersion, State: TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive,
		CreatedAt: now.UTC(), UpdatedAt: now.UTC(),
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(interaction)
}

func NewS5OnboardingInteractionFromPrompt(binding TeacherDialogBinding, messageID string, messageVersion int, assistantUI json.RawMessage, step TeacherOnboardingStep, draftVersion, profileVersion int64, sessionSchemaVersion int, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	normalizedBinding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	slot, hasSlot := TeacherOnboardingSlotForStep(step)
	messageID = strings.TrimSpace(messageID)
	if err != nil || !hasSlot || normalizedBinding.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral || !validUUID(messageID) || messageVersion < 1 || draftVersion < 0 || profileVersion < 0 || now.IsZero() {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	digest, err := DigestTeacherAssistantUI(assistantUI)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(TeacherOnboardingInteraction{
		ID:       DeterministicOnboardingUUID("interaction", normalizedBinding.ID, messageID, messageVersion, digest, slot, draftVersion, profileVersion, sessionSchemaVersion),
		DialogID: normalizedBinding.ID, StudentID: normalizedBinding.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: normalizedBinding.PersonalTeacherID,
		PromptMessageID: messageID, PromptMessageVersion: int64(messageVersion), PromptAssistantUIDigest: digest, SlotCode: slot,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: draftVersion, ExpectedProfileVersion: profileVersion, SessionSchemaVersion: sessionSchemaVersion, State: TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive,
		CreatedAt: now.UTC(), UpdatedAt: now.UTC(),
	})
}

// NewS5ConfirmationInteraction binds the registry-generated confirmation
// prompt to the single persisted high-impact proposal. The proposal stays in
// the originating S5 turn; the interaction retains only its slot and frozen
// message evidence, so a browser action cannot inject a value.
func NewS5ConfirmationInteraction(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, decision TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, draftVersion, profileVersion int64, sessionSchemaVersion int, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	return NewS5ConfirmationInteractionForResponse(binding, message, "", decision, draftVersion, profileVersion, sessionSchemaVersion, now)
}

// NewS5ConfirmationInteractionForResponse is the reply-anchored equivalent
// for the server-generated confirmation UI.
func NewS5ConfirmationInteractionForResponse(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, replyToMessageID string, decision TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, draftVersion, profileVersion int64, sessionSchemaVersion int, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	normalizedBinding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	normalizedDecision, decisionErr := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(decision)
	if err != nil || decisionErr != nil || normalizedDecision.Kind != TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation || normalizedDecision.Candidate == nil ||
		normalizedBinding.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral || draftVersion < 0 || profileVersion < 0 || now.IsZero() {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	validated, validationErr := newS5TeacherPromptMessage(normalizedBinding, message, replyToMessageID)
	if validationErr != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	digest, digestErr := DigestTeacherAssistantUI(validated.AssistantUI)
	if digestErr != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(TeacherOnboardingInteraction{
		ID:       DeterministicOnboardingUUID("interaction-confirmation", normalizedBinding.ID, validated.ID, validated.Version, digest, normalizedDecision.Digest, normalizedDecision.Candidate.Slot, draftVersion, profileVersion, sessionSchemaVersion),
		DialogID: normalizedBinding.ID, StudentID: normalizedBinding.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: normalizedBinding.PersonalTeacherID,
		PromptMessageID: validated.ID, PromptMessageVersion: int64(validated.Version), PromptAssistantUIDigest: digest, SlotCode: normalizedDecision.Candidate.Slot,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: draftVersion, ExpectedProfileVersion: profileVersion, SessionSchemaVersion: sessionSchemaVersion, State: TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive,
		CreatedAt: now.UTC(), UpdatedAt: now.UTC(),
	})
}

func newS5TeacherPromptMessage(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, replyToMessageID string) (DialogMessage, error) {
	replyToMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(replyToMessageID)
	if replyToMessageID == "" {
		return NewDialogTeacherStructuredProactive(binding, message, message.Body, message.AssistantUI)
	}
	if !validUUID(replyToMessageID) || strings.TrimSpace(message.ReplyToMessageID) != replyToMessageID {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	// Reuse the strict legacy proactive validation for every field other than
	// reply_to_message_id, then restore the independently validated Dialog
	// reply anchor. This keeps the proactive contract unchanged while S5
	// accepts the exact shape produced by Dialog's Teacher response endpoint.
	withoutReply := message
	withoutReply.ReplyToMessageID = ""
	validated, err := NewDialogTeacherStructuredProactive(binding, withoutReply, message.Body, message.AssistantUI)
	if err != nil {
		return DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	validated.ReplyToMessageID = replyToMessageID
	return validated, nil
}

// IsS5TextMutableSlot implements the intentionally narrow one-call path.
// High impact/disambiguated slots always receive a deterministic confirmation
// interaction; model output alone cannot mutate them.
func IsS5TextMutableSlot(slot TeacherOnboardingSlotCode) bool {
	return slot == TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience || slot == TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage ||
		slot == TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes || slot == TeacherOnboardingSlotPace
}

// CanAdvanceTeacherOnboardingTurn is intentionally a small monotone state
// graph. Repository updates bind both the expected current stage and the
// Teacher job claim token, so retries cannot jump a partially observed turn.
func CanAdvanceTeacherOnboardingTurn(from, to TeacherOnboardingTurnStage) bool {
	switch from {
	case TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived:
		return to == TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect
	case TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved:
		return to == TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect
	case TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged:
		return to == TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect
	case TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged:
		return to == TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect
	case TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged:
		return to == TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect
	case TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending:
		return to == TeacherOnboardingTurnDelivered || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown || to == TeacherOnboardingTurnFailedNoEffect
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func DigestTeacherAssistantUI(raw json.RawMessage) (string, error) {
	if _, err := strictAssistantUI(raw); err != nil {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err != nil {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(canonical)
	if err != nil {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

// TeacherStudentOnboardingTurn* are the closed S3 wire contract mirrored at
// the Teacher boundary. They intentionally contain no generic JSON/map and
// are never accepted from a browser or an LLM.
const (
	TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSchema       = "student-onboarding-turn.v2"
	TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema = "student-onboarding-turn-result.v2"
	TeacherStudentOnboardingProofSchema      = "student-onboarding-turn-no-effect-proof.v2"
)

type TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnOrigin string

const (
	TeacherStudentTurnExplicitUI   TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnOrigin = "explicit_ui"
	TeacherStudentTurnExplicitText TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnOrigin = "explicit_text"
)

type TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot struct {
	SlotCode              TeacherOnboardingSlotCode          `json:"slot_code"`
	CodeValue             *string                            `json:"code_value,omitempty"`
	TextValue             *string                            `json:"text_value,omitempty"`
	StacksValue           *[]string                          `json:"stacks_value,omitempty"`
	IntegerValue          *int                               `json:"integer_value,omitempty"`
	Origin                TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnOrigin `json:"origin"`
	ConfidenceBasisPoints *int                               `json:"confidence_basis_points,omitempty"`
}

type TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand struct {
	Schema                    string                             `json:"schema"`
	StudentCommandID          string                             `json:"student_command_id"`
	DialogID                  string                             `json:"dialog_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID         string                             `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	TeacherTurnSequence       int64                              `json:"teacher_turn_sequence"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string                             `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
	ActionReceiptID           *string                            `json:"action_receipt_id,omitempty"`
	SourceEventID             string                             `json:"source_event_id"`
	DialogCausationID         string                             `json:"dialog_causation_id"`
	TeacherJobID              string                             `json:"teacher_job_id"`
	AIExecutionID             *string                            `json:"ai_execution_id,omitempty"`
	CorrelationID             string                             `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID               string                             `json:"causation_id"`
	ExpectedDraftVersion      int64                              `json:"expected_draft_version"`
	ExpectedProfileVersion    *int64                             `json:"expected_profile_version,omitempty"`
	FinalizeCurrentV1         bool                               `json:"finalize_current_v1"`
	Slots                     []TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot `json:"slots"`
}

type TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult struct {
	Schema                    string  `json:"schema"`
	StudentCommandID          string  `json:"student_command_id"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string  `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
	StudentEffectState        string  `json:"student_effect_state"`
	ResultDraftVersion        *int64  `json:"result_draft_version,omitempty"`
	ResultProfileVersion      *int64  `json:"result_profile_version,omitempty"`
	NoEffectProofID           *string `json:"no_effect_proof_id,omitempty"`
	Replayed                  bool    `json:"replayed"`
}

type TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof struct {
	Schema  string                              `json:"schema"`
	Command TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand `json:"command"`
}

func NewTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand(input TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	for _, value := range []string{input.StudentCommandID, input.DialogID, input.PersonalTeacherID, input.CanonicalStudentMessageID, input.SourceEventID, input.DialogCausationID, input.TeacherJobID, input.CorrelationID, input.CausationID} {
		if !validUUID(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
			return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	}
	if input.Schema != TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSchema || input.TeacherTurnSequence < 1 || input.ExpectedDraftVersion < 0 ||
		input.DialogCausationID != input.CanonicalStudentMessageID || input.FinalizeCurrentV1 || input.ExpectedProfileVersion != nil || len(input.Slots) < 1 || len(input.Slots) > 9 {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if input.ActionReceiptID != nil {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(*input.ActionReceiptID)
		if !validUUID(value) || input.AIExecutionID != nil || input.CorrelationID != value || input.CausationID != input.TeacherJobID {
			return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		input.ActionReceiptID = &value
	} else if input.AIExecutionID != nil {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(*input.AIExecutionID)
		if !validUUID(value) || input.CorrelationID != input.CanonicalStudentMessageID || input.CausationID != value {
			return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		input.AIExecutionID = &value
	} else {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	seen := make(map[TeacherOnboardingSlotCode]struct{}, len(input.Slots))
	for index := range input.Slots {
		slot, err := normalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot(input.Slots[index], input.ActionReceiptID != nil)
		if err != nil {
			return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, err
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[slot.SlotCode]; duplicate {
			return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		seen[slot.SlotCode] = struct{}{}
		input.Slots[index] = slot
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot(input TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot, action bool) (TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot, error) {
	if !validTeacherOnboardingSlot(input.SlotCode) || input.ConfidenceBasisPoints == nil || *input.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 0 || *input.ConfidenceBasisPoints > 10000 {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if action && (input.Origin != TeacherStudentTurnExplicitUI || *input.ConfidenceBasisPoints != 10000) ||
		!action && input.Origin != TeacherStudentTurnExplicitText {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	valueCount := 0
	if input.CodeValue != nil {
		*input.CodeValue = strings.TrimSpace(*input.CodeValue)
		valueCount++
	}
	if input.TextValue != nil {
		*input.TextValue = strings.TrimSpace(*input.TextValue)
		valueCount++
	}
	if input.StacksValue != nil {
		values := append([]string(nil), (*input.StacksValue)...)
		for index := range values {
			values[index] = strings.TrimSpace(values[index])
		}
		input.StacksValue = &values
		valueCount++
	}
	if input.IntegerValue != nil {
		valueCount++
	}
	if valueCount != 1 {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

// BuildS5DeterministicActionTurn is the only action->Student conversion. It
// reuses the fixed Teacher registry, so a browser-supplied action never turns
// into arbitrary profile data and it performs zero AI calls.
func BuildS5DeterministicActionTurn(job TeacherDialogJob, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction, receipt OnboardingActionReceipt) (TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand, bool, error) {
	if job.Request.ActionReceiptID == "" || job.Request.ActionReceiptID != receipt.IdempotencyKey ||
		receipt.ExecutionMode != OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical || receipt.Status != OnboardingReceiptMaterialized ||
		!validUUID(receipt.StudentCommandID) ||
		job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID != receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID || job.Request.ReplyToMessageID != interaction.PromptMessageID ||
		interaction.State != TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved || interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID ||
		interaction.ReservedActionReceiptID != receipt.IdempotencyKey || interaction.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	slotCode, hasSlot := TeacherOnboardingSlotForStep(receipt.Step)
	if !hasSlot {
		// S5 never finalizes v1; a confirmation action is a response-only turn.
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, false, nil
	}
	if interaction.SlotCode != slotCode {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	_, policyVersion, _, policyOK := onboardingBlockIdentity(receipt.BlockID)
	choice, found := onboardingChoiceForPolicy(receipt.Step, receipt.ActionID, policyVersion)
	if !policyOK || !found {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	confidence := 10000
	slot := TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{SlotCode: slotCode, Origin: TeacherStudentTurnExplicitUI, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence}
	switch slotCode {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks:
		values := []string{}
		if choice.Value != "" {
			values = []string{choice.Value}
		}
		slot.StacksValue = &values
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		values := []string{choice.Value}
		slot.StacksValue = &values
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
		value := choice.Minutes
		slot.IntegerValue = &value
	default:
		value := choice.Value
		slot.CodeValue = &value
	}
	actionReceiptID := receipt.IdempotencyKey
	command := TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{
		Schema: TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSchema, StudentCommandID: receipt.StudentCommandID,
		DialogID: job.Request.DialogID, PersonalTeacherID: job.Request.PersonalTeacherID,
		TeacherTurnSequence: job.Request.TeacherTurnSequence, CanonicalStudentMessageID: job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID,
		ActionReceiptID: &actionReceiptID, SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID, DialogCausationID: job.Request.DialogCausationID,
		TeacherJobID: job.TeacherJobID, CorrelationID: job.Request.CorrelationID, CausationID: job.TeacherJobID,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion, FinalizeCurrentV1: false, Slots: []TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{slot},
	}
	normalized, err := NewTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand(command)
	return normalized, err == nil, err
}

// BuildS5ConfirmedProposalTurn is deterministic even though the original
// proposal came from semantic interpretation: the value is read only from the
// local persisted decision, then explicitly accepted by the canonical UI
// confirmation action. Dialog never transports that value.
func BuildS5ConfirmedProposalTurn(job TeacherDialogJob, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction, receipt OnboardingActionReceipt, decision TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision) (TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand, bool, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(decision)
	if err != nil || normalized.Kind != TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation || normalized.Candidate == nil || receipt.Step != OnboardingStepConfirmation ||
		normalized.Candidate.Slot != interaction.SlotCode || !actionReceiptMatchesConfirmation(job, interaction, receipt) {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, false, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	confidence := 10000
	candidate := normalized.Candidate
	slot := TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{SlotCode: candidate.Slot, Origin: TeacherStudentTurnExplicitUI, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence}
	switch candidate.Slot {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks, TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		values := append([]string(nil), candidate.StringListValue...)
		slot.StacksValue = &values
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
		value := candidate.IntegerValue
		slot.IntegerValue = &value
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText:
		value := candidate.TextValue
		slot.TextValue = &value
	default:
		value := candidate.CodeValue
		slot.CodeValue = &value
	}
	actionReceiptID := receipt.IdempotencyKey
	command := TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{
		Schema: TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSchema, StudentCommandID: receipt.StudentCommandID,
		DialogID: job.Request.DialogID, PersonalTeacherID: job.Request.PersonalTeacherID,
		TeacherTurnSequence: job.Request.TeacherTurnSequence, CanonicalStudentMessageID: job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID,
		ActionReceiptID: &actionReceiptID, SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID, DialogCausationID: job.Request.DialogCausationID,
		TeacherJobID: job.TeacherJobID, CorrelationID: job.Request.CorrelationID, CausationID: job.TeacherJobID,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion, FinalizeCurrentV1: false, Slots: []TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{slot},
	}
	command, err = NewTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand(command)
	return command, err == nil, err
}

func actionReceiptMatchesConfirmation(job TeacherDialogJob, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction, receipt OnboardingActionReceipt) bool {
	return job.Request.ActionReceiptID != "" && job.Request.ActionReceiptID == receipt.IdempotencyKey && receipt.ExecutionMode == OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical &&
		receipt.Status == OnboardingReceiptMaterialized && receipt.ActionID == "confirmation.confirm" && receipt.StudentID == job.Request.StudentID &&
		receipt.PersonalTeacherID == job.Request.PersonalTeacherID && receipt.DialogID == job.Request.DialogID && receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID == job.Request.SourceMessageID &&
		job.Request.ReplyToMessageID == interaction.PromptMessageID && interaction.State == TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved &&
		interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID == job.TeacherJobID && interaction.ReservedActionReceiptID == receipt.IdempotencyKey && interaction.ReservationMode == TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction
}

// BuildS5TextSemanticRequest is the single typed semantic input for an
// attached free-text turn. The Dialog body stays transient; the Teacher turn
// contains only the causal execution UUID, never model output or draft data.
func BuildS5TextSemanticRequest(job TeacherDialogJob, turn TeacherOnboardingTurn, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction, state TeacherStudentOnboardingState, source, prompt DialogMessage) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest, error) {
	if job.Request.ActionReceiptID != "" || job.Request.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral || !job.Request.HasFrozenOnboardingReplyMetadata() ||
		turn.Mode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText || turn.TeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID || turn.SourceEventID != job.Request.EventID ||
		turn.InteractionID != interaction.ID || !validUUID(turn.CausalAIExecutionID) || interaction.State != TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved ||
		interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID || interaction.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText ||
		source.ID != job.Request.SourceMessageID || source.DialogID != job.Request.DialogID || source.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorUser || source.SenderID != job.Request.StudentID ||
		source.Status != 1 || source.Version != int(job.Request.SourceMessageVersion) || source.ReplyToMessageID != interaction.PromptMessageID ||
		prompt.ID != interaction.PromptMessageID || prompt.DialogID != job.Request.DialogID || prompt.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher || prompt.PersonalTeacherID != job.Request.PersonalTeacherID || prompt.Status != 1 || prompt.Version != int(interaction.PromptMessageVersion) {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	digest, digestErr := DigestTeacherAssistantUI(prompt.AssistantUI)
	if digestErr != nil || digest != interaction.PromptAssistantUIDigest {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	normalizedState, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingState(state, job.Request.StudentID)
	if err != nil || normalizedState.Draft.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftDraft || normalizedState.Draft.Version != interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion || normalizedState.ProfileVersion != interaction.ExpectedProfileVersion {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	request := TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{
		AIExecutionID: turn.CausalAIExecutionID, LanguageCode: OnboardingLocale(normalizedState.Draft),
		Variables: TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{
			StudentTurn: TeacherOnboardingSemanticStudentTurn{Text: source.Body},
			OnboardingState: TeacherOnboardingSemanticOnboardingState{
				State: "draft", DraftVersion: normalizedState.Draft.Version, ProfileVersion: normalizedState.ProfileVersion,
				// Student is authoritative for provenance. Its existing v1 state
				// read does not expose provenance, so never fabricate origins here.
				AcceptedSlots:     []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{},
				ActiveInteraction: TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction{Kind: "question", UIKind: "choice", PromptText: prompt.Body, ExpectedSlots: []string{string(interaction.SlotCode)}},
			},
			DialogContext: DialogTeacherOnboardingSemanticContext(prompt.Body),
			SemanticStage: TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage{Kind: "default", Reason: "", PriorCandidateSlots: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{}},
		},
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest(request)
}

// DialogTeacherOnboardingSemanticContext keeps the semantic request's
// free-text payload typed and bounded without copying Dialog history.
func DialogTeacherOnboardingSemanticContext(prompt string) TeacherOnboardingSemanticDialogContext {
	return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDialogContext{Summary: "", ActiveTeacherPrompt: prompt}
}

// SelectS5TextMutation accepts only the one-call, low-risk path. Everything
// else (high impact slots, ambiguity, questions, tangents, corrections) is a
// response-only turn that preserves the active deterministic interaction.
func SelectS5TextMutation(result TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate, bool) {
	if len(result.SlotCandidates) != 1 || len(result.Questions) != 0 || len(result.Uncertainties) != 0 {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{}, false
	}
	candidate := result.SlotCandidates[0]
	if candidate.Slot != interaction.SlotCode || candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 9000 || !IsS5TextMutableSlot(candidate.Slot) {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{}, false
	}
	return candidate, true
}

// NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision freezes the validated first semantic
// result before any Student effect. A one-candidate high-impact answer becomes
// a proposal for a server-owned confirmation; uncertain/multi-slot output is
// response-only and leaves the current interaction intact.
func NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(result TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(result)
	if err != nil || interaction.SlotCode == "" {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	decision := TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{Kind: TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionResponseOnly}
	if candidate, ok := SelectS5TextMutation(normalized, interaction); ok {
		copyCandidate := cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(candidate)
		decision.Kind, decision.Candidate = TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation, &copyCandidate
	} else if len(normalized.SlotCandidates) == 1 && len(normalized.Questions) == 0 && len(normalized.Uncertainties) == 0 {
		candidate := normalized.SlotCandidates[0]
		if candidate.Slot == interaction.SlotCode && candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints >= 9000 && !IsS5TextMutableSlot(candidate.Slot) {
			copyCandidate := cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(candidate)
			decision.Kind, decision.Candidate = TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation, &copyCandidate
		}
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(decision)
}

// NewProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision accepts multiple exact,
// high-confidence, low-risk facts from the one existing semantic execution.
// Every extra fact must be absent from the authoritative Student snapshot;
// direction and desired stack remain explicit-confirmation candidates.
func NewProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(result TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction, state TeacherStudentOnboardingState) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(result)
	if err != nil || interaction.SlotCode == "" || state.Draft.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftDraft || state.Draft.Version != interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion || state.ProfileVersion != interaction.ExpectedProfileVersion {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	decision := TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{Kind: TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionResponseOnly, PolicyVersion: TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2}
	if len(normalized.Questions) == 0 && len(normalized.Uncertainties) == 0 && len(normalized.SlotCandidates) > 0 {
		accepted := make([]TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate, 0, len(normalized.SlotCandidates))
		containsActive := false
		allLowRisk := true
		for _, candidate := range normalized.SlotCandidates {
			if candidate.Slot == interaction.SlotCode {
				containsActive = true
			}
			if candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 9000 || !isProductAwareLowRiskCandidate(candidate) || draftAnswerPresentForSlot(state.Draft, candidate.Slot) {
				allLowRisk = false
				break
			}
			accepted = append(accepted, cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(candidate))
		}
		if allLowRisk && containsActive {
			decision.Kind, decision.Candidates = TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation, accepted
		} else if len(normalized.SlotCandidates) == 1 {
			candidate := normalized.SlotCandidates[0]
			if candidate.Slot == interaction.SlotCode && candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints >= 9000 && isProductAwareHighImpactCandidate(candidate) && !draftAnswerPresentForSlot(state.Draft, candidate.Slot) {
				copyCandidate := cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(candidate)
				decision.Kind, decision.Candidate = TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation, &copyCandidate
			}
		}
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(decision)
}

func isProductAwareLowRiskCandidate(candidate TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate) bool {
	switch candidate.Slot {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode:
		return candidate.CodeValue == "learn_programming"
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience:
		return candidate.CodeValue == "beginner" || candidate.CodeValue == "basic" || candidate.CodeValue == "intermediate" || candidate.CodeValue == "advanced"
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage:
		return candidate.CodeValue == "ru" || candidate.CodeValue == "en"
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func isProductAwareHighImpactCandidate(candidate TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate) bool {
	switch candidate.Slot {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection:
		return candidate.CodeValue == "undecided" || candidate.CodeValue == "backend" || candidate.CodeValue == "frontend" || candidate.CodeValue == "fullstack" || candidate.CodeValue == "data"
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		return len(candidate.StringListValue) == 1 && candidate.StringListValue[0] == "go"
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func draftAnswerPresentForSlot(draft StudentOnboardingDraft, slot TeacherOnboardingSlotCode) bool {
	switch slot {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection:
		return draft.DirectionCode != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience:
		return draft.SelfAssessedExperience != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks:
		return draft.KnownStacks != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		return draft.DesiredStacks != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode:
		return draft.GoalCode != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText:
		return draft.GoalText != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage:
		return draft.PreferredLanguage != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
		return draft.WeeklyMinutes != nil
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotPace:
		return draft.PreferredPace != nil
	default:
		return true
	}
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(input TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, error) {
	if input.Candidate != nil {
		// Reuse the strict S4 candidate validator with a deliberately inert
		// transient response. Only the normalized selected candidate survives
		// this boundary; model wording and unselected candidates never do.
		validated, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
			Schema: TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "_",
			SlotCandidates: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(*input.Candidate)},
			Questions:      []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
		})
		if err != nil || len(validated.SlotCandidates) != 1 {
			return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		candidate := cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(validated.SlotCandidates[0])
		input.Candidate = &candidate
	}
	if input.Candidates != nil {
		if len(input.Candidates) == 0 || len(input.Candidates) > TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidateMaximum {
			return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		validated, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
			Schema: TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "_", SlotCandidates: append([]TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(nil), input.Candidates...),
			Questions: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		input.Candidates = make([]TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate, len(validated.SlotCandidates))
		for index := range validated.SlotCandidates {
			input.Candidates[index] = cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(validated.SlotCandidates[index])
			if !isProductAwareLowRiskCandidate(input.Candidates[index]) || input.Candidates[index].ConfidenceBasisPoints < 9000 {
				return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
		}
	}
	if input.PolicyVersion != 0 && input.PolicyVersion != TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	switch input.Kind {
	case TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation:
		if (input.Candidate == nil) == (len(input.Candidates) == 0) || (len(input.Candidates) > 0 && input.PolicyVersion != TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2) {
			return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation:
		if input.Candidate == nil || len(input.Candidates) != 0 || (input.PolicyVersion == 0 && IsS5TextMutableSlot(input.Candidate.Slot)) ||
			(input.PolicyVersion == TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 && !isProductAwareHighImpactCandidate(*input.Candidate)) {
			return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionResponseOnly:
		if input.Candidate != nil || len(input.Candidates) != 0 {
			return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Kind          TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionKind `json:"kind"`
		Candidate     *TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate   `json:"candidate,omitempty"`
		Candidates    []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate  `json:"candidates,omitempty"`
		PolicyVersion int                                   `json:"policy_version,omitempty"`
	}{Kind: input.Kind, Candidate: input.Candidate, Candidates: input.Candidates, PolicyVersion: input.PolicyVersion})
	if err != nil || len(encoded) == 0 || len(encoded) > 16<<10 {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	digest := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	if input.Digest != "" && strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Digest)) != digest {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	input.Digest = digest
	return input, nil
}

func cloneTeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate(value TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate) TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate {
	if value.StringListValue != nil {
		copied := make([]string, len(value.StringListValue))
		copy(copied, value.StringListValue)
		value.StringListValue = copied
	}
	return value
}

// BuildS5InterpretedTextTurn converts the validated advisory candidate into a
// closed Student command. The model never supplies IDs, origins, versions or
// a mutation target outside the currently reserved low-risk slot.
func BuildS5InterpretedTextTurn(job TeacherDialogJob, turn TeacherOnboardingTurn, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction, candidate TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate) (TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand, error) {
	if job.Request.ActionReceiptID != "" || turn.Mode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText || turn.TeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID ||
		turn.SourceEventID != job.Request.EventID || turn.InteractionID != interaction.ID || !validUUID(turn.StudentCommandID) ||
		!validUUID(turn.CausalAIExecutionID) || interaction.State != TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved || interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID ||
		interaction.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText || candidate.Slot != interaction.SlotCode || !IsS5TextMutableSlot(candidate.Slot) || candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 9000 {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	confidence := candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints
	slot := TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{SlotCode: candidate.Slot, Origin: TeacherStudentTurnExplicitText, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence}
	switch candidate.Slot {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks, TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		values := append([]string(nil), candidate.StringListValue...)
		slot.StacksValue = &values
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
		value := candidate.IntegerValue
		slot.IntegerValue = &value
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText:
		value := candidate.TextValue
		slot.TextValue = &value
	default:
		value := candidate.CodeValue
		slot.CodeValue = &value
	}
	aiExecutionID := turn.CausalAIExecutionID
	return NewTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand(TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{
		Schema: TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSchema, StudentCommandID: turn.StudentCommandID,
		DialogID: job.Request.DialogID, PersonalTeacherID: job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, TeacherTurnSequence: job.Request.TeacherTurnSequence,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID, SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID,
		DialogCausationID: job.Request.DialogCausationID, TeacherJobID: job.TeacherJobID, AIExecutionID: &aiExecutionID,
		CorrelationID: job.Request.CorrelationID, CausationID: aiExecutionID, ExpectedDraftVersion: interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion,
		FinalizeCurrentV1: false, Slots: []TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{slot},
	})
}

func BuildProductAwareInterpretedTextTurn(job TeacherDialogJob, turn TeacherOnboardingTurn, interaction TeacherOnboardingInteraction, decision TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision) (TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand, error) {
	decision, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(decision)
	if err != nil || decision.Kind != TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation || decision.PolicyVersion != TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 || len(decision.Candidates) == 0 ||
		job.Request.ActionReceiptID != "" || turn.Mode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText || turn.TeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID || turn.SourceEventID != job.Request.EventID ||
		turn.InteractionID != interaction.ID || !validUUID(turn.StudentCommandID) || !validUUID(turn.CausalAIExecutionID) || interaction.State != TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved ||
		interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID || interaction.ReservationMode != TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	containsActive := false
	slots := make([]TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot, 0, len(decision.Candidates))
	for _, candidate := range decision.Candidates {
		if !isProductAwareLowRiskCandidate(candidate) || candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 9000 {
			return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		containsActive = containsActive || candidate.Slot == interaction.SlotCode
		slot, slotErr := semanticCandidateStudentSlot(candidate)
		if slotErr != nil {
			return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, slotErr
		}
		slots = append(slots, slot)
	}
	if !containsActive {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	aiExecutionID := turn.CausalAIExecutionID
	return NewTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand(TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand{
		Schema: TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSchema, StudentCommandID: turn.StudentCommandID,
		DialogID: job.Request.DialogID, PersonalTeacherID: job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, TeacherTurnSequence: job.Request.TeacherTurnSequence,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID, SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID,
		DialogCausationID: job.Request.DialogCausationID, TeacherJobID: job.TeacherJobID, AIExecutionID: &aiExecutionID,
		CorrelationID: job.Request.CorrelationID, CausationID: aiExecutionID, ExpectedDraftVersion: interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion,
		FinalizeCurrentV1: false, Slots: slots,
	})
}

func semanticCandidateStudentSlot(candidate TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate) (TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot, error) {
	confidence := candidate.ConfidenceBasisPoints
	slot := TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot{SlotCode: candidate.Slot, Origin: TeacherStudentTurnExplicitText, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence}
	switch candidate.Slot {
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks, TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		values := append([]string(nil), candidate.StringListValue...)
		slot.StacksValue = &values
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
		value := candidate.IntegerValue
		slot.IntegerValue = &value
	case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText:
		value := candidate.TextValue
		slot.TextValue = &value
	default:
		value := candidate.CodeValue
		slot.CodeValue = &value
	}
	return normalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnSlot(slot, false)
}
